label: Tanec
desc: Pohupuje se do rytmu, krok stranou, ruce nahoru, otočka a zklidnění.
desc_en: Sways to the beat, a step to the side, arms up, a spin and a settle.
style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, one slow continuous movement, calm steady tempo
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands

beats.prompt: the dancer starts to sway their hips gently side to side, arms loose and relaxed, feet in place, and ends mid-sway with weight centered
the dancer steps to one side and shifts their weight onto that leg while both arms rise to shoulder height, and ends there
the dancer turns halfway away from the camera and back again in one smooth motion, hair swinging with the turn, and ends facing the camera with arms out
the dancer raises both arms above their head as their hips sway, head tilting once to each side, and ends with arms up
the dancer lowers their arms, the sway slows to a stop, the dancer exhales and ends standing still, smiling at the camera
